description: This file defines a namespace QtJson with functions and a class for parsing, serializing, and manipulating JSON data using Qt's QVariant types. It includes functions for cloning, inserting, appending, parsing, serializing JSON data, and managing date/time formats.

classes.name: QtJson::Object
classes.description: A QVariant subclass providing convenient methods for manipulating JSON objects, including key insertion, removal, and operator overloads for array-like access.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a JSON object represented as QVariant.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into a JSON object (QVariantMap).

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a value to a JSON array (QVariantList).

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a QVariant hierarchy.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Generates a textual JSON representation (UTF-8 QByteArray) from QVariant data.

methods.name: serializeStr
methods.description: Generates a textual JSON representation (QString) from QVariant data.

methods.name: setDateTimeFormat
methods.description: Sets the date/time format for QDateTime::toString.

methods.name: setDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the date format for QDateTime::toString.
